lead: Lady Gaga is best known as an American singer, born on 28 March 1986 in Lenox Hill Hospital.
As of 2026, she is 40 years old, and her birth date places her under the Aries sign.

She is associated with work such as Christmas Tree, Eh, Eh (Nothing Else I Can Say) and The Fame and has been recognised with MTV Video Music Award for Best New Artist and MTV Video Music Award for Best Art Direction.
This profile collects the Lady facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Lady Gaga — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Lady Gaga was born on 28 March 1986 in Lenox Hill Hospital, and holds American nationality. She was given the name Stefani Joanne Angelina Germanotta at birth and is publicly known as Lady Gaga.
Public records name her father, Joe Germanotta and her mother, Cynthia Germanotta. She is a sibling of Natali Germanotta.
She received her education at Convent of the Sacred Heart, Collaborative Arts Project 21, New York University Tisch School of the Arts and Lee Strasberg Theatre and Film Institute.
She is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Lady Gaga — Career and Professional Work
paras: Lady Gaga works primarily as a singer and songwriter.
Among the credits most often linked to Lady are Christmas Tree, Eh, Eh (Nothing Else I Can Say), The Fame, Just Dance, Poker Face, Paparazzi, The Fame Monster, Bad Romance, Telephone and Alejandro.
She performs on piano and voice.
She has taken part in Lollapalooza, Royal Variety Performance, Brit Awards 2010, Saturday Night Live and Dick Clark's New Year's Rockin' Eve.
